headlines.title: Seagate Sinks 8%, Western Digital Down 6% on Election, Memory Price Worries
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares fell 8% today as investors sold data center and storage stocks after the midterm elections, with Western Digital down too. Seagate has little exposure to flash memory prices, and most of its drive supply is allocated under contracts through 2028, so the drop looks overdone.

headlines.title: SanDisk Retreats 9%, Micron and Western Digital Fall 7% as Election and Memory Price Worries Weigh
headlines.summary: Memory stocks are buckling under a convergence of election fallout and pricing pressure even as AI data-center demand stays strong, leaving SanDisk investors caught between record revenue and a deepening selloff.

headlines.title: Western Digital's Q1 Beat and Q2 Outlook Signal More Margin Upside
headlines.summary: Western Digital's strong pricing, higher-capacity drives and AI storage demand fuel margin growth, but valuation and technology execution risks remain in focus.

headlines.title: Is WDC a Buy as Earnings Surge but Valuation and Execution Risks Rise?
headlines.summary: Western Digital's surging earnings, expanding margins and strong cash flow bolster its growth case, but premium valuation and HAMR execution risks warrant caution.

headlines.title: Western Digital Falls 15.5% in One Month. Is the Dip a Buying Chance?
headlines.summary: Western Digital's stock pullback contrasts with surging earnings and cloud demand, but premium valuation and execution risks raise questions about buying the dip.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
